main_measure.name: OLS slope of next-day excess return on forecast (day-clustered t)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: t >= 2 with forecast-weighted mean excess > 0; reject: t <= -2

supporting_check.name: forecast-weighted mean excess return of cases > 0

decided_by: The slope has a t of 2 or more and the forecast-weighted mean excess return is above 0.
reading: Profile bars are those with regime 'unknown' (not vetoed to chop); the drop is the recorded raw oc_drop value, recomputed from open/close where missing; the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all its within-window 1-bar returns; cluster-robust SE uses the usual G/(G-1)*(N-1)/(N-K) correction; days are UTC dates of the bar; the plan's minimum counts give 'not observable' when unmet.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
